 CORAM: HONOURABLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE  and  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE BIBEK CHAUDHURI  ORAL ORDER  (Per: HONOURABLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE)
2 31-01-2026 1.

This writ petition has been filed by the Petitioner, Mr. Madhav Raj, who is learned counsel for this Court, seeking for following reliefs:-
"i. To direct the Respondent Authorities to form a regulatory body for effective regulation of private hostels in the State of Bihar to protect the students from any sort of harassment and exploitation and further for uniform rules for operations, staffing, and service quality across all private hostels,
ensuring consistency.

ii. To direct the Respondent Authorities to provide/give list of private hostels running in Patna High Court CWJC No.1142 of 2026(2) dt.31-01-2026 the State of Bihar without the permission of the authorities and are not registered under THE SARAIS ACT, 1867 and without complying with other requirements i.e. No Objection Certificates from Fire Services, Electricity Board, and Pollution Control Board etc.

iii. To direct the respondent authorities to take necessary steps to close all the private hostels specially the girl's hostels running without registration/valid license and without permission of the concerned authorities for securing/preventing sexual, physical and other violence against them inside the hostel premises.

iv. To proceed against the officials found guilty for not maintaining the data/record and are responsible for letting private hostels run without valid registration/license and NOCs from the Madhav Raj (In- Person) vs The State Of Bihar on 31 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45400572/
1 various statutory bodies.
v. To hold a high-powered enquiry by an independent agency or judicial enquiry to examine the truthfulness of suspicious/mysterious death of a minor girl child living in the Shambhu Patna High Court CWJC No.1142 of 2026(2) dt.31-01-2026 Girls Hostel, falling within Chitragupta Nagar Police Station within Patna District and further after ascertaining the truth to take appropriate legal action against the erring officials and doctors who is/are found responsible/accountable for the same."
2. The Petitioner submits that he is interested in the security of minor boys and girls inside the private hostels which are being run without valid license/registration and without confirming with other mandatory legal requirements.

sentences.text: 3. It is further stated that in the State of Bihar, there is no regulatory body to command or to regulate the running of the private hostels and the provisions of SARAIS Act, 1867 not being followed.

4. It is further stated that the girls staying in such private hostels are facing a lot of problems, viz.,
proper safety and security, quality of food, unhygienic drinking water and sanitation,.
Some instances have been highlighted in the writ petition.

5. When we made a query as to whether there is any such Act in any of the State, the Petitioner has placed before us Tamil Nadu Hostels and Homes for Women and Children Patna High Court CWJC No.1142 of 2026(2) dt.31-01-2026 (Regulation) Act, 2014, which is taken on record.

entities.text: Tamil Nadu Hostels and Homes for Women and Children Patna High Court
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
6. On perusal of the same, it transpires that it provides regarding licensing of the hostel, lodging houses and homes for women and children registration of homes for women and children,
appointment of manager, his duties and responsibilities, safety and security measures and penalty for the violation of any provisions including not obtaining the license etc.
The copy of the 2014 Act is taken on record.
A copy has also been handed over to the State in course of the day.

7. Let the State obtain specific instruction regarding the status of SARAIS Act, 1867 and whether the State has formulated any such Act like 2014 Act or contemplating to enact any such provision for regulating the hostels, lodging houses and homes for women and children and other like institutions.
8.
Affidavit to that effect shall be filed by a responsible officer of the State by the next date fixed.

9. Put up this matter on 20.2.2026.
(Sangam Kumar Sahoo, CJ) ( Bibek Chaudhuri, J) uttam/-
